meaning: Water level sensor error: LG says the PE code indicates that the washer's water level sensor is malfunctioning.
causes: A malfunctioning water level sensor, the cause LG gives
A temporary error that can clear after a short power reset
diySteps: Plug the washer back in and restart the cycle
safetyNote: Unplug the washer (or switch off its breaker) and close the water taps before you reach behind it, handle hoses or open a filter. Water left from a recent hot cycle can be very hot, so let it cool first. Never bypass the door lock. Motor, pump, valve, sensor and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If PE persists after the 10-second power reset, LG says the washer will require a repair service. The water level sensor is an internal part, so this is technician work.
sourceTitle: LG Front Load Washer – Error Code List (LG USA Support)
